create_dot_dataset: create a DotDataset with DotDatasetConfig to generate synthetic dot navigation samples for JEPA training
render_dot_locations: render dot locations as grayscale images using render_location with a tensor of 2D coordinates
generate_actions: generate biased random walk actions using Von Mises angle distribution and truncated normal step sizes
convert_xy_to_polar: convert Cartesian coordinate tensors to polar coordinates with angle and norm using xy_to_polar
convert_polar_to_xy: convert polar coordinate tensors back to Cartesian coordinates using polar_to_xy
